decisions.reason: A two-component resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's plural-component pumping and injection expertise, so it can interpret early results and refine the product.
A second resin injection unit sits within the firm's core plural-component knowledge and serves its existing construction customers, though overlap with A carries slight consolidation risk.
Automatic airless spray guns are central to the firm's spray application know-how and its in-house manufacturing, which supports learning and improvement.
A manual airless spray gun is a core accessory closely tied to the firm's established equipment base and customer needs.
Air-assisted airless technology is an adjacent extension of the firm's airless spray expertise, so its absorptive capacity covers it well.

A data logger involves electronics and software knowledge further from the firm's mechanical core, which raises risk, but it complements the coating equipment and the firm's engineering staff can still assimilate the feedback.
